claim_scope: Repository-disjoint development qualification; not final test or leaderboard evidence.

hypothesis.problem: Small verified repairs currently repay the full environment-construction prefix in every fresh candidate.
hypothesis.mechanism: Search in a persistent construction state, retain it only after executable postconditions classify the transition as reusable, and require the exact complete program to pass one clean fresh replay before acceptance.
hypothesis.primary: Postcondition-persistent explicit-state search improves or preserves Official Pass@1 relative to the frozen fresh-state explicit method while reducing repeated construction work on cases that require repair.
hypothesis.secondary: Explicit constraints remain useful under the same persistence mechanism relative to bounded raw goal history.

shared_contract.integrity_protocol: repository integrity v5 plus open-program validation
shared_contract.token_policy: Tokens and price are reported outcomes; configured limits are emergency guards, not research stopping thresholds.

schedule.within_case_order: cyclic three-condition rotation fixed by selection rank
schedule.cross_case_execution: May interleave across available hosts, but each case preserves its frozen within-case order.
schedule.host_policy: Mac is the initial host; another validated host may execute whole case blocks under the identical commit, config semantics, image, and protocol.

mechanism_metrics: reusable, damaged, and unknown transition counts
clean replay attempts and pass rate
descriptive_metrics: input, cached, output, and reasoning tokens
reported price under the frozen pricing snapshot
integrity_gate: Every reused state has an earlier state-transition-observation with disposition reusable and matching lineage.
Damaged and unknown states are released before another candidate executes.
Every certified terminal candidate is the same complete script that passed a fresh clean-replay verification.
No Official evaluator finding enters any online model input or constraint update.
Every terminal Official result uses an identity-matched fresh environment and passes repository integrity.
analysis.proceed_rule: Retain the mechanism for the next repository-disjoint round if the integrity gate passes, persistent-explicit does not reduce Official Pass@1, and at least one repair trajectory demonstrates verified cross-candidate reuse without a clean-replay regression.
analysis.failure_rule: If the integrity gate fails, fix measurement before interpreting effectiveness. If the mechanism gate fails, archive all five repositories as consumed and redesign only from internal trajectories, then select a new metadata-only repository-disjoint batch.
analysis.infrastructure_retry_policy: Retry only a preregistered infrastructure-censored episode with the same code, settings, seed, and case; never replace a case based on outcome.
